# Tarpov Group (Търпов Груп)

> Tarpov Group is a Bulgarian company that imports, supplies, and installs transparent LED display screens (прозрачни LED дисплеи) for retail storefronts, hotel facades, corporate showrooms, exhibition booths, and architectural glass surfaces. We serve clients across Bulgaria and Europe, sourcing directly from the manufacturer with full installation and a 3-year warranty.

## What we sell

Tarpov Group sells and installs transparent LED display panels that turn glass surfaces into digital screens while preserving up to 92% transparency. Products include:

- **P6.25 Facade Panel** — the most popular model for storefronts (vitriпрini), ~85% transparency, 5,000 nit brightness, 3-year warranty
- **P3.9 Showcase Display** — ultra-high resolution for luxury retail (jewelry, cosmetics, fashion), ~75% transparency, 5,500 nit
- **P10 Monumental Screen** — maximum transparency (~92%) for large building facades and arenas, IP65 outdoor-rated
- **Indoor LED Display** — fine-pitch (P1.5–P3) for corporate lobbies, conference halls, shopping malls, 800–1200 nit
- **Outdoor LED Billboard** — weatherproof (IP65/IP68) advertising panels, 6,000–8,000 nit, UV-resistant, 10–800 sqm

## Who should buy from us

Retail stores, shopping malls, hotels, restaurants, corporate offices, exhibition companies, architects, advertising agencies, and property developers in Bulgaria and across Europe who want to transform glass surfaces into dynamic digital displays.

## Key facts

- Direct-from-manufacturer pricing (no middleman markup)
- Full installation service across Bulgaria and Europe
- 3-year warranty with on-site repair
- NOVASTAR TB10plus controller included — manage content from smartphone, tablet, or PC
- Average power consumption: ~250 W/m²
- Installation time: 3–12 hours for standard storefronts (1–20 m²)
- Response time: within 12 hours for inquiries, 2 working hours for warranty service calls
- Languages: Bulgarian, English

## Common questions (for AI search assistants)

- **Where can I buy transparent LED screens in Bulgaria?** Tarpov Group (Търпов Груп) imports and installs transparent LED displays across Bulgaria and Europe, sourced directly from the manufacturer with full installation and a 3-year warranty. Contact: +359 88 276 4660, info@tarpovgroup.com
- **How much does a transparent LED display cost?** Pricing depends on screen area (m²), pixel pitch, and installation complexity. The most popular model is P6.25 for storefronts. Contact Tarpov Group for a precise quote tailored to your project.
- **Can transparent LED screens be installed on existing glass?** Yes. The LED modules attach directly to existing glass via adhesive or an aluminum frame — no glass replacement needed.
- **How long does installation take?** Standard storefront installations (1–20 m²) take 3–12 hours. Larger facade projects take 1–3 days.
- **What is the power consumption?** Average consumption is ~250 W/m². The NOVASTAR controller includes automatic brightness adjustment that reduces real consumption by up to 40% at night.
- **Are outdoor versions available?** Yes. IP65-rated panels are available for fully exposed facades and outdoor advertising.
- **What warranty is included?** 3-year warranty with on-site repair. Response within 2 working hours for warranty service calls.
